changeSet.author: Artem Prokudin

preConditions.onFailMessage: education_resource: host-only LMS has an https:// duplicate that is already referenced; merge them manually
preConditions.sqlCheck: select count(*) from education_resource old_er join education_resource dup on dup.type = old_er.type and dup.url = concat('https://', lower(old_er.url)) where old_er.url not like '%://%' and (exists(select 1 from course c where c.education_resource_id = dup.id) or exists(select 1 from external_account ea where ea.education_resource_id = dup.id) or exists(select 1 from permission_scope ps where ps.kind = 'EDUCATION_RESOURCE' and ps.scope_item_id = dup.id))

changeSet.sql:
delete dup from education_resource dup join education_resource old_er on old_er.type = dup.type and dup.url = concat('https://', lower(old_er.url)) where old_er.url not like '%://%';
update education_resource set url = concat('https://', lower(url)) where url not like '%://%';
